variablesInModel.Name: arrival time
variablesInModel.Description: Arrival time of train i at the station n (Table A.2); also written a_{i,n+1} and a_{j,n}.

variablesInModel.Name: departure time
variablesInModel.Description: Departure time of train i from station n (Table A.2). Judgement: d_{i,p} at block section p ((3c), (6o)) counts here: Table A.2 defines no separate variable and (6o) calls it the departure time from block section p.

variablesInModel.Name: running time
variablesInModel.Description: Running time of train i between stations n and n+1 (Table A.2). r_{i,n,n'} in (6p)-(6q) is defined in Sect. 4.5 as the sum of r_{i,\tilde{n}} for \tilde{n} = n..n'-1: same family.

variablesInModel.Name: kinetic energy per mass unit
variablesInModel.Description: Kinetic energy per mass unit of train i in the k-th cell between consecutive stops n and n' (Table A.2).

variablesInModel.Name: traction or braking force
variablesInModel.Description: Traction or braking force of train i in the k-th cell between consecutive stops n and n' (Table A.2); printed u_{i,n,n'k} in line 6 of (13), same family.

variablesInModel.Name: arrival time at a cell
variablesInModel.Description: Arrival time of train i at the k-th discrete cell between consecutive stops n and n'. Table A.2 prints t_{i,n,n'k} (comma before k missing); the equations write t_{i,n,n',k}.

variablesInModel.Name: departure order at a station
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i leaves station n earlier than train j, for i, j in I_s (same direction) (Table A.2).

variablesInModel.Name: order on the unblocked track
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i in I_b uses the unblocked track between stations n and n+1 earlier than train j in I \ I_b (Table A.2).

variablesInModel.Name: rerouting to the unblocked track
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i from the blocked track is rerouted to the unblocked track between stations n and n+1 (Table A.2). The prose of Sect. 4.4 once writes pi_i.

variablesInModel.Name: departure after W_1
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i departs from station n after W_1 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: departure before W_2
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i departs from station n before W_2 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: departure inside the disruption window
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if Omega^d_{i,n,1} = 1 and Omega^d_{i,n,2} = 1 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: arrival after W_1
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i arrives at station n+1 after W_1 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: arrival before W_2
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if train i arrives at station n+1 before W_2 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: arrival inside the disruption window
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if Omega^a_{i,n+1,1} = 1 and Omega^a_{i,n+1,2} = 1 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable).

variablesInModel.Name: train spans the disruption window
variablesInModel.Description: Binary, 1 if Omega^d_{i,n,1} = 0 and Omega^a_{i,n+1,2} = 0 (Table A.2, auxiliary variable). Indexed by i only, although (4g)-(4i) are written for every n.

variablesInModel.Name: absolute departure deviation
variablesInModel.Description: Auxiliary variable of Appendix D, \tilde{d}_{i,n} = |d_{i,n} - \overline{d}_{i,n}|, linearized by lines 1-2 of (13).

variablesInModel.Name: absolute arrival deviation
variablesInModel.Description: Auxiliary variable of Appendix D, \tilde{a}_{i,n} = |a_{i,n} - \overline{a}_{i,n}|, linearized by lines 3-4 of (13).

variablesInModel.Name: positive part of the force
variablesInModel.Description: Auxiliary variable of Appendix D, max(0, u); introduced there as \tilde{u}_{i,k} = max(0, u_{i,k}), written \tilde{u}_{i,n,n',k} in (13). Linearized by lines 7-10 of (13).

variablesInModel.Name: sign indicator of the force
variablesInModel.Description: Binary variable of Appendix D indicating whether u_{i,n,n',k} is greater than 0 (lines 5-10 of (13)).

variablesInModel.Name: segment indicators of the PWA time approximation
variablesInModel.Description: delta_k = [delta^1_k delta^2_k delta^3_k]^T, auxiliary binaries of Appendix C; enter (6j) through G = (6h). (12d)-(12g), which tie them to E, are not listed in (13), so delta occurs only in (6j).

variablesInModel.Name: products of the PWA time approximation
variablesInModel.Description: z_k = [z^1_k z^2_k z^3_k]^T, real-valued z^m_k = delta^m_k E_k of Appendix C; enter (6j) through G = (6h). (12g), which defines them, is not listed in (13), so z occurs only in (6j).

objective_functions.Name: (13) objective: weighted absolute timetable deviations plus traction energy
objective_functions.description: Linear form of objective (1): \tilde{d}, \tilde{a} stand for |d - \overline{d}|, |a - \overline{a}| and \tilde{u} for max(0, u) (Appendix D). w_1, w_2 and Delta s are parameters, so linear. Compact form in this field.

constraints.Name: (13) line 1: departure deviation at least d - dbar
constraints.description: First line of (13); the ten lines are unnumbered in the paper. With line 2, \tilde{d}_{i,n} \ge |d_{i,n} - \overline{d}_{i,n}| (Appendix D). Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 2: departure deviation at least dbar - d
constraints.description: Second half of the absolute-value linearization of the departure deviation. Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 3: arrival deviation at least a - abar
constraints.description: With line 4, \tilde{a}_{i,n} \ge |a_{i,n} - \overline{a}_{i,n}| (Appendix D). Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 4: arrival deviation at least abar - a
constraints.description: Second half of the absolute-value linearization of the arrival deviation. Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 5: phi = 1 forces a non-negative force u
constraints.description: Big-M, linear. The quantifier is printed k \in K_{i,n} (not K_{i,n,n'}); kept as printed.

constraints.Name: (13) line 6: phi = 0 forces a non-positive force u
constraints.equation: u_{i,n,n'k} \le M \cdot \phi_{i,n,n',k} \ , \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: Big-M, linear. Printed u_{i,n,n'k} (comma before k missing) and k \in K_{i,n}; kept as printed, same family u.

constraints.Name: (13) line 7: positive part at most u when phi = 1
constraints.equation: \tilde{u}_{i,n,n',k} \le u_{i,n,n',k} + M(1 - \phi_{i,n,n',k}) \ , \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: \tilde{u} \le u when phi = 1, relaxed by big-M when phi = 0. Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 8: positive part at least u when phi = 1
constraints.equation: \tilde{u}_{i,n,n',k} \ge u_{i,n,n',k} - M(1 - \phi_{i,n,n',k}) \ , \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: \tilde{u} \ge u when phi = 1; with line 7, \tilde{u} = u = max(0, u). Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 9: positive part at most 0 when phi = 0
constraints.description: \tilde{u} \le M phi: zero when phi = 0. Linear.

constraints.Name: (13) line 10: positive part at least 0 when phi = 0
constraints.description: \tilde{u} \ge -M phi; with line 9, \tilde{u} = 0 when phi = 0. Linear.

constraints.Name: (2a) running time between consecutive stations
constraints.equation: r_{i,n} = a_{i,n+1} - d_{i,n}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, n, n+1 \in \mathcal{N}_i
constraints.description: The running time r_{i,n} equals the arrival at station n+1 minus the departure from station n.

constraints.Name: (2b) no departure before the planned departure time
constraints.description: Departure time at least the planned departure time \overline{d}_{i,n} (a parameter). A bound, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (2c) minimum dwell time
constraints.description: Departure minus arrival at least the planned dwell time \overline{p}_{i,n}.

constraints.Name: (2d) minimum running time
constraints.description: Running time at least r^{min}_{i,n}, a parameter that Table A.1 does not list. A bound, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (3a) arrival headway between same-direction trains
constraints.equation: a_{j,n} - a_{i,n} \ge h_a - M(1 - \lambda_{i,j,n-1}), \qquad \forall i, j \in \mathcal{I}_s, i \ne j, n-1, n \in \mathcal{N}_i \cap \mathcal{N}_j
constraints.description: Arrival headway h_a, relaxed by big-M unless train i precedes train j at the previous station n-1 (lambda_{i,j,n-1}). Linear.

constraints.Name: (3b) departure headway at stations
constraints.equation: d_{j,n} - d_{i,n} \ge h_d - M(1 - \lambda_{i,j,n}), \qquad \forall i, j \in \mathcal{I}_s, i \ne j, n \in \mathcal{N}_i \cap \mathcal{N}_j
constraints.description: Departure headway h_d at station n, big-M on lambda_{i,j,n}. Linear.

constraints.Name: (3c) departure headway at block sections
constraints.equation: d_{j,p} - d_{i,p} \ge h_s - M(1 - \lambda_{i,j,n}), \qquad \forall i, j \in \mathcal{I}_s, i \ne j, p \in \mathcal{P}_{n,n+1}, n, n+1 \in \mathcal{N}_i \cap \mathcal{N}_j
constraints.description: Headway h_s at every block section p between n and n+1, order lambda_{i,j,n}. d_{j,p}, d_{i,p} are departure times at block sections, counted in family d. Linear.

constraints.Name: (3d) one of two trains departs first
constraints.description: Exactly one of lambda_{i,j,n} and lambda_{j,i,n} is 1.

constraints.Name: (4a) departure after W_1 indicator
constraints.description: Omega^d_{i,n,1} = 1 iff d_{i,n} \ge W_1. A double inequality, one constraint; division by the constant M, so linear.

constraints.Name: (4b) departure before W_2 indicator
constraints.description: Omega^d_{i,n,2} = 1 iff d_{i,n} \le W_2. Double inequality, one constraint; linear.

constraints.Name: (4c) departure inside the disruption window
constraints.description: Omega^d_{i,n,3} = Omega^d_{i,n,1} AND Omega^d_{i,n,2}. One number for a system of three inequalities, counted once. Compact form in this field.

constraints.Name: (4d) arrival after W_1 indicator
constraints.description: Arrival counterpart of (4a): Omega^a_{i,n+1,1} = 1 iff a_{i,n+1} \ge W_1. Linear.

constraints.Name: (4e) arrival before W_2 indicator
constraints.description: Arrival counterpart of (4b): Omega^a_{i,n+1,2} = 1 iff a_{i,n+1} \le W_2. Linear.

constraints.Name: (4f) arrival inside the disruption window
constraints.description: Omega^a_{i,n+1,3} = Omega^a_{i,n+1,1} AND Omega^a_{i,n+1,2}. Three inequalities under one number, counted once. Compact form in this field.

constraints.Name: (4g) train spans the disruption window
constraints.description: Omega^s_i = 1 iff Omega^d_{i,n,1} = 0 and Omega^a_{i,n+1,2} = 0. Three inequalities under one number, counted once. Compact form in this field.

constraints.Name: (4h) rerouting when a disruption indicator is active
constraints.description: pi_{i,n} = 1 if any of Omega^d_{i,n,3}, Omega^a_{i,n+1,3}, Omega^s_i is 1. M times a binary, linear.

constraints.Name: (4i) rerouting only if a disruption indicator is active
constraints.description: pi_{i,n} can be 1 only if at least one of the three indicators is 1. Linear.

constraints.Name: (5a) single-track headway at station n+1
constraints.equation: d_{j,n+1} - a_{i,n+1} \ge h_{ad} - M(2 - \gamma_{i,j,n} - \pi_{i,n}), \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}_b, j \in \mathcal{I} \setminus \mathcal{I}_b, n, n+1 \in \mathcal{N}_i \cap \mathcal{N}_j \cap \overline{\mathcal{N}}
constraints.description: Headway h_ad between the arrival of blocked-track train i and the departure of opposite train j at n+1, enforced when gamma_{i,j,n} = pi_{i,n} = 1. Big-M, linear.

constraints.Name: (5b) single-track headway at station n
constraints.equation: d_{i,n} - a_{j,n} \ge h_{ad} - M(1 + \gamma_{i,j,n} - \pi_{i,n}), \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}_b, j \in \mathcal{I} \setminus \mathcal{I}_b, n, n+1 \in \mathcal{N}_i \cap \mathcal{N}_j \cap \overline{\mathcal{N}}.
constraints.description: Headway h_ad between the arrival of train j and the departure of train i at station n, enforced when gamma_{i,j,n} = 0 and pi_{i,n} = 1. Big-M, linear.

constraints.Name: (6i) kinetic energy of the next cell
constraints.equation: E_{i,n,n',k+1} = \varphi_1 E_{i,n,n',k} + \varphi_2 u_{i,n,n',k} + \varphi_{3,k}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: Printed E_{k+1} = H(E_k, u_k). H is the mapping (6g), substituted here; varphi_1, varphi_2, varphi_{3,k} are coefficients (Appendix B). (6g) is not among the constraints (13) lists. Linear.

constraints.Name: (6j) arrival time at the next cell
constraints.equation: t_{i,n,n',k+1} = t_{i,n,n',k} + A E_{i,n,n',k} + B u_{i,n,n',k} + C\delta_k + C\delta_{k+1} + D z_k + D z_{k+1} + e, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}.
constraints.description: Printed t_{k+1} = G(t, E, u); G is (6h), substituted, although its printed arguments omit delta and z. A, B, e and vectors C, D are coefficients (App. C): linear. (12d)-(12g), which tie delta, z to E, are not listed in (13).

constraints.Name: (6k) minimum kinetic energy in the first and last cell
constraints.equation: E_{i,n,n',k} = E_{\min}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}^1_{i,n,n'} \cup \mathcal{K}^2_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: Kinetic energy equals E_min at the start and end positions of the cell set between stops n and n'. A bound, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (6l) kinetic energy bounds
constraints.equation: E_{\min} \le E_{i,n,n',k} \le E_{\max}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: E_min \le E \le E_max; parameter bounds, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (6m) traction and braking force bounds
constraints.equation: u_{\min} \le u_{i,n,n',k} \le u_{\max}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}.
constraints.description: u_min \le u \le u_max; parameter bounds, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (6n) time at the first cell equals the departure time
constraints.equation: t_{i,n,n',k} = d_{i,n}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}^1_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: Couples the cell times to the departure time d_{i,n} from station n.

constraints.Name: (6o) departure time at a block section
constraints.equation: d_{i,p} = d_{i,n} + t_{i,n,n',k}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, p \in \mathcal{P}_{n,n'}, p = \mu \times k, k \in \mathcal{K}^1_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: d_{i,p} at block section p = mu x k equals d_{i,n} plus the cell time. Printed k \in K^1_{i,n,n'} (starting position) and P_{n,n'}; kept as printed. d_{i,p} counted in family d.

constraints.Name: (6p) time at the last cell equals departure plus running time
constraints.equation: t_{i,n,n',k} = d_{i,n} + r_{i,n,n'}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}^2_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}
constraints.description: t at the end position equals d_{i,n} + r_{i,n,n'}; r_{i,n,n'} is the sum of r_{i,\tilde{n}} over the stations from n to n'-1 (Sect. 4.5), family r.

constraints.Name: (6q) cell times within the running time window
constraints.equation: d_{i,n} \le t_{i,n,n',k} \le d_{i,n} + r_{i,n,n'}, \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, k \in \mathcal{K}_{i,n,n'}, n, n' \in \mathcal{N}_i^{\text{stop}}.
constraints.description: Every cell time lies between the departure d_{i,n} and d_{i,n} + r_{i,n,n'}. Double inequality, one constraint; linear.
